note: Lock law the UI must obey. Loom revises. Nymph commits. Cloth lives in velora-wardrobe-walk-scale.json — do not duplicate fabric here.

camera.walk: Chest height. Full body. Floor visible. Lamp at head height. Not a hero poster.
camera.street: Street height. Buildings 2–5 storeys. People knee-to-waist. Not aerial god-shot. Not dollhouse.
camera.lookbook: Chest height. Cloth first. Body fills the frame. Architecture is weather only.
camera.partner: Walking-scale shell beside a person. Door or second figure in frame so the shell cannot inflate.
camera.node: Building is the subject. Humans small. One violet band at storey-line.
camera.sheet: Studio, even light, plain dark ground. Four views on one plate. Same camera distance on body panels.

ground.kittyOnSeat: 16-inch figure ON the chair seat. Chair back taller than her head. Chair is human-sized. She is not sitting in it like an adult.
ground.adultInChair: Walk-in IN the chair. Back against the backrest. Feet on the floor. Not perched on the cushion like a figurine.
ground.kittyPalm: Whole body shorter than an adult forearm. Head no larger than a knuckle. Solo ruler.
ground.kittyShin: Head at shin, below mid-thigh. Tall body is the stick. No chair.
ground.kittyPlate: Standing next to an adult as scale. Both full body. Same floor.
ground.lookOnly: Identity sheet. No chair, palm, knee, or scale partner. Size is not locked.

scaleInvert.rule: Never load Kitty chair/palm/shin bible on a wardrobe Build.

pairFail.detail: Two bibles. One Build. Split them.
A partner is a ruler. Switch to shin or plate.
Classic flip. She is cat-sized, or drop the extra cat.
Node makes humans small. She vanishes unless she is the subject.

stillToI2v.note: The still is the scale. I2V is motion only. Do not re-argue tiny/height in the motion prompt.

imagine.lead: Photorealistic cinematic still, full body, floor visible, sharp focus.
imagine.nsfwGate: Identity stills only. Strip adult tags and try again.

comfy.order: scale + identity before BREAK, scene after
comfy.note: Comfy paste is the weighted pack. Imagine paste is the still sentence. Do not feed one to the other.

negative.base: blurry, deformed, extra limbs, bad anatomy, cropped, out of frame, text, watermark, child, loli, toddler, baby
negative.kitty: full-size Chaos Kitty, same-height couple, giantess flip, extra tiny figure, doll, gremlin, miniature doll, human ears, blonde hair, identical second catgirl, cat standing beside identical cat, breast inflation, huge breasts

sheetPlate.lock: one person, identical face, identical outfit
